# Anki Word Bank

> > Frequency-based Anki flashcard decks with native audio for 10+ languages including Spanish, French, German, Italian, and Japanese, aligned with proficiency standards like JLPT, DELF/DALF, and DELE.

Anki Word Bank offers curated vocabulary decks built on frequency analysis and spaced repetition principles, featuring native speaker audio and context sentences. Premium decks cost $5 with a 30-day money-back guarantee and support 9 front languages for non-English learners.

## Key Topics

- Anki decks
- Native audio
- Spaced repetition
- Frequency-based vocabulary
- JLPT (Japanese Language Proficiency Test)
- DELF/DALF (French proficiency)
- DELE (Spanish proficiency)
- Dual coding theory
- Phonological memory
- Zipf's Law
- Context-based learning
- Multilingual flashcards
- iOS and Android compatibility
- Vocabulary acquisition research
- Language comprehension thresholds
